event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
CAN 216264 was represented by Ryan ANDERSON.
The race committee was represented by Javier Blanco (Course Race Officer for ILCA 7).
The protest time limit for the ILCA 7 Men Yellow fleet was 16:30 on 12 August 2025.
CAN 216264 submitted a scoring inquiry at 16:04 on 12 August 2025.
The race committee published its decision on the scoring inquiry at 18:05.
CAN 216264 submitted a request for redress at 18:39.
The race committee presented video evidence during the hearing.
facts: The race committee displayed the black flag as preparatory signal during the start of race 3 for ILCA 7 Men Yellow fleet.
The race committee identified CAN 216264 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last seconds before the starting signal.
The race committee signalled a general recall after the starting signal and displayed the sail number of CAN 216264 on the race committee signal boat before the next warning signal.
CAN 216264 did not sail in race 3.
CAN 216264 was scored BFD in race 3 by the race committee.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
